Deciles are calculated by ranking the 32,844 neighbourhoods in England from most deprived to least deprived and dividing them into 10 equal groups. These range from the most deprived 10% of neighbourhoods nationally to the least deprived 10% of neighbourhoods nationally.  These graphs below are based on the LD Cohort in Gloucestershire, and show factors which may affect the Cohort, and indicate where positive intervention might be necessary.
